description: Vidar exports a flat key/value system summary under `information.txt`, `system.txt`, or `systeminfo.txt`. The stable field set combines `GUID`, `HWID`, `Install Date`, `Work Dir`, keyboard languages, and display details.
name: Vidar
targets: Browser saved credentials, cookies, autofill, history
Crypto wallet extensions and desktop clients
Documents and screenshots from the desktop
FTP, email, and VPN client configurations
